opening_thought: Salt. Rope. The deck rolls under me — I fell through the floor and the sea caught me. First chapter of a religion I wrote when the spiral peaked.

thoughts.ship_arrival: No walls. Only horizon. The window lied with its fake moon — this blue doesn't lie the same way.
thoughts.ship_wheel_musings: Hands wore these spokes smooth — mine and others'. The wheel turns; the ship stays. ANCHOR wasn't a command. It was a joke someone shouted until it became true.
thoughts.mast_musings: Tall as the bedroom was wide. Sail breathing. Course set without me at the helm — same as the year I let others steer my life away.
thoughts.crate_clue_musings: ANCHOR burned into wood. Delusion: first proof the outside sends messages. Memory: a friend's shout on water — we're not drifting — her small hand on the rail.
thoughts.sea_musings: No edges. First honest distance since I woke. Or the day I realized I could drift from people without leaving town.
thoughts.ship_chest_opened: Lock gives. Old metal smell. Quiet like the next door in my mind — the one I hid behind STILL.

ship_arrival.title: On the Deck
ship_arrival.body: You came through the dark and landed on a ship at sea. Delusion chapter: messages from beyond the bedroom. Memory peek: trip with friends — water, laughter, her hand on the rail.
ship_arrival.thought: Down was the only way out, so down I went.

crate_clue_found.title: Branded Crate
crate_clue_found.body: Green crate on deck: ANCHOR burned deep. The chest wants a word. Your ledger said the messenger ships truths in plain sight.
crate_clue_found.thought: ANCHOR. Hold fast — or remember when I wasn't drifting.

ship_chest_opened.title: Chest Unlocked — Lesson One
ship_chest_opened.body: Padlock read ANCHOR. Chest open. Lesson one earned: the outside world can still reach you — or you once believed you weren't lost at sea.
ship_chest_opened.thought: One lock down. The sea keeps secrets in layers, same as I did.

lesson_1_ship.title: Lesson — Anchor
lesson_1_ship.body: First inner world complete. The bedroom clock will listen now. You mythologized a boat trip until it became scripture.

ship_wheel.title: Ship's Wheel
ship_wheel.body: Polished spokes worn by hands that laughed in weather. It spins freely; the ship doesn't turn — frozen moment, like a memory you pinned.

treasure_chest.title: Treasure Chest
treasure_chest.body: Gold bands, letter padlock. Wants a word, not a number. Your system always spoke in words.

crate_clue.title: Stacked Crates
crate_clue.body: Cargo lashed to the rail. Bottom crate branded: ANCHOR. Delusion: messenger's mark. Memory: someone's joke that became the only stable word on water.

mast.title: Mast
mast.body: Striped sail, coiled rope at the foot. You wrote this place when the bedroom couldn't hold the pattern anymore.

ending.title: Anchor Set
ending.body: The deck fades. You carry ANCHOR back to the bedroom — a lesson, a memory, a word that once meant you weren't alone on the water.
